preconditions.description: n is the number of time-steps (1 ≤ n ≤ 200) and m is the number of target banana counts (2 ≤ m ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 2 for t_i, _, _ in operations) and all(1 <= y_i <= m for _, _, y_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation has a type t_i (1 or 2) and a bound y_i (1 ≤ y_i ≤ m).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for t_i, x_prime_i, _ in operations if t_i == 1) and all(10**5 < x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for t_i, x_prime_i, _ in operations if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 1, x'_i is in [1, 10^5 * m]; for type 2, x'_i is in (10^5, 10^5 * m].
The input contains exactly n operations.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == m and all(1 <= j <= m for j in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is a list of exactly m integers, one for each target banana count j from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(output[j - 1] == -1 or (1 <= output[j - 1] <= n) for j in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: For each target j, output[j - 1] is either -1 (impossible) or a valid time-step index (1 ≤ output[j - 1] ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: all((output[j - 1] == -1) or (exists(sequence, k_sequence) where (len(sequence) == output[j - 1]) and (k_sequence[0] == 0) and (all(k_sequence[i] == k_sequence[i - 1] if a_i == 0 else (k_sequence[i] == ceil(k_sequence[i - 1] + x_i) if t_i == 1 else k_sequence[i] == ceil(k_sequence[i - 1] * x_i)) for i in range(1, output[j - 1] + 1)) and (k_sequence[output[j - 1]] == j))) for j in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: For each target j, if output[j - 1] is not -1, there exists a sequence of operations and choices of a_i such that after applying the first output[j - 1] operations, exactly j bananas are obtained.

postconditions.expression: all((output[j - 1] == -1) or (all(output[k - 1] == -1 or output[k - 1] > output[j - 1] for k in range(1, j))) for j in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: If a target j is reachable, its earliest time-step is strictly before any later reachable target k > j.
